decisions.reason: Operator training is a low-cost service that supports machine sales and customer retention, so a CNC machinery maker typically keeps it.
A fourth rotary axis is a standard, complementary accessory for CNC milling machines and adds value to the core product line at little extra cost.
Hybrid additive post-processing is a niche, more experimental offering that was only mentioned on the website, which makes it the riskiest product, but it still positions the firm in a growth area.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is core business, had its own page, and machines of this kind usually stay on the market for many years.
An automatic tool change system is an integral option for CNC machines, supports automation demand, and complements the main machine line.
